change.source: engine/search tests 174 passed with the browser lane (cargo test -- --include-ignored, the lane 18 tests in 6.2 s). One test per acceptance line, each failing before the change: refused before the first variant (campaign_live::a_mode_the_page_does_not_show_is_refused_before_the_first_variant_is_rendered); notes once where the same (campaign::the_notes_name_an_element_once_when_it_is_the_same_in_every_environment_and_variant, campaign_live::the_notes_name_an_element_once_when_it_is_the_same_everywhere); a mode or a viewport that measures what another one measures (campaign::a_mode_or_a_viewport_that_measures_what_another_one_measures_is_named, campaign_live::an_environment_that_changes_no_number_is_named); restriction to one variant and one environment, no file the report ranks (campaign_live::a_run_restricted_to_one_variant_and_one_environment_is_no_campaign, campaign::the_renders_of_a_restricted_run_are_not_reported, campaign::campaign_run_refuses_a_restriction_the_declaration_does_not_have); screenshots of the same bytes, the caret hidden (campaign_live::two_runs_write_screenshots_of_the_same_bytes, campaign_live::a_shot_taken_later_is_the_same_bytes, which failed on tight.set.640x480-dark.png without the fix); the attribute refusal says the page changed it after it was ready (campaign_live::a_page_that_changes_the_modes_attribute_after_it_was_ready_is_refused). Decided: text_under_14 stays a share; a declaration that gains a key gets a new format name (docs/targets.md)
